## Libraries

```{r libraries, include=TRUE, warning=FALSE}

# Load libraries
library(readxl)
library(here)
library(janitor)
library(tidyverse)
library(corrplot)
library(sf)
library(tmap)
library(leaflet)
```

## Dataset Cleaning

### Dementia Dataset

```{r dementia_dataset}

# Read the dataset
aihw_data <- read_excel(here("Data", "aihw_dementia_prev.xlsx"), 
                         sheet = 10,
                         na = c("", "NA", "^", "..", "...", "n.p.")) %>%
  clean_names()

# View the first five rows in the dataset
head(aihw_data)

colnames(aihw_data)
```

```{r check_duplicate_for_PHA}

# Checking PHA code duplicate
duplicate_name <- aihw_data %>%
  filter(duplicated(sa2_name) | duplicated(sa2_name, fromLast=TRUE)) %>%
  nrow()

duplicate_name
```

### PHA Dataset

Load the PHA Dataset to be used for further analysis

```{r pha_dataset}
# read the PHA file
pha_path <- here("Data", "sa2_to_pha.xlsx")

# Read the PHA dataset
pha_data <- read_excel(pha_path, sheet = 1) %>% 
  clean_names()

head(pha_data)
```

```{r}
# add the sa2 code from pha_data to aihw_data
sa2_lookup <- pha_data %>%
  select(sa2_name, sa2_code) %>%
  distinct()

aihw_data <- aihw_data %>%
  left_join(sa2_lookup, by = c("sa2_name" = "sa2_name"))

# Cek hasil beberapa baris teratas
head(aihw_data)
```

## Population

ABS ASGS Ed3 SA2 2021 Regional population by age and sex 2024 (Digital Atlas of Australia)

```{r}
aihw_pop <- read_excel(here("Data", "AIHW_pop.xlsx"),
                       sheet = 1,
                       na = c("", "NA", "^", "..", "...", "n.p.")) %>%   
  clean_names()
```

```{r}
# Add total persons from aihw_pop to aihw data

aihw_data <- aihw_data %>%
  mutate(sa2_code = as.character(sa2_code))

pop_lookup <- aihw_pop %>%
  select(sa2_code, total_persons) %>%
  distinct(sa2_code, .keep_all = TRUE)

aihw_data <- aihw_data %>%
  left_join(pop_lookup, by = "sa2_code")

head(aihw_data)
colnames(aihw_data)
```

## SA2 to PHA

```{r}

# Create a lookup table for PHA and SA2 mapping from pha_data
pha_lookup <- pha_data %>%
  mutate(sa2_code = as.character(sa2_code)) %>%
  select(sa2_code, 
         pha_code = pha_code, 
         pha_name = pha_name) %>%
  distinct(sa2_code, .keep_all = TRUE)

# Aggregate counts and population from SA2 to PHA level
aihw_data <- aihw_data %>%
  mutate(sa2_code = as.character(sa2_code)) %>%
  left_join(pha_lookup, by = "sa2_code") %>%
  group_by(pha_code, pha_name) %>%
  summarise(
    total_dementia_cases_aihw = sum(persons, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_pop = sum(total_persons, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop") %>%
  # Dementia prevalence
  mutate(
    aihw_dementia_rate = (total_dementia_cases_aihw / total_pop) * 100
  )

# Check the first few rows of the aggregated PHA dataset
head(aihw_data)
```

## PHA Map Final Dataset

```{r}
comb_paf <- readRDS(here("combined_paf.rds"))
```

```{r}
comb_paf <- comb_paf %>%
  mutate(pha_code = as.character(pha_code))

aihw_data <- aihw_data %>%
  mutate(pha_code = as.character(pha_code))

# Join AIHW dementia rate with the Combined PAF dataset
combined_data <- comb_paf %>%
  left_join(aihw_data %>% select(pha_code,
                                 aihw_dementia_rate,
                                 total_dementia_cases_aihw),
            by = "pha_code")

```

### Correlation Check

```{r}
# Extract correlation variables clean of spatial geometry and vector names
cor_vars <- combined_data %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  mutate(
    combined_paf_add_smooth = as.numeric(as.vector(combined_paf_add_smooth)),
    aihw_dementia_rate = as.numeric(as.vector(aihw_dementia_rate))
  ) %>%
  select(combined_paf_add_smooth, aihw_dementia_rate) %>%
  drop_na()

# Compute Pearson and Spearman correlation matrices
pearson_corr <- cor(cor_vars, method = "pearson")
spearman_corr <- cor(cor_vars, method = "spearman")

cat("--- Pearson Correlation Matrix ---\n")
print(round(pearson_corr, 3))

cat("\n--- Spearman Correlation Matrix ---\n")
print(round(spearman_corr, 3))


```

```{r}
# Scatterplot: Combined PAF vs. AIHW Dementia Rate
ggplot(combined_data, aes(x = combined_paf_add_smooth, 
                          y = aihw_dementia_rate)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4, color = "#2b5c8f") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "#d95f02", se = TRUE) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  labs(
    title = "Combined PAF (Additive) vs AIHW Modelled Dementia Rate",
    subtitle = "Aggregated at Population Health Area (PHA) Level",
    x = "Combined PAF (%)",
    y = "AIHW Modelled Dementia Prevalence (%)"
  )
```

-   **Positive Correlation:** Both Pearson (r = 0.222) and Spearman (p = 0.257) indicate a weak-to-moderate positive relationship, showing that areas with a higher *Combined PAF* tend to have higher AIHW dementia prevalence.

-   **Scatter Plot:** The upward trendline confirms the positive association, while the broad data dispersion reflects small-area variability, demonstrating that modifiable risk factors provide complementary spatial variation alongside baseline demographic rates.
